summary: FASE H-7 & H-8 testing completed successfully. All backend APIs and frontend UI features working correctly. Unified delivery notes from 3 sources (gudang, vendor, buyer) displaying properly with filters, PDF downloads, and navigation. All 4 menu aliases (H-8) redirecting correctly to modules with data.
passed_tests: BACKEND A: GET /api/wms/delivery-notes/sources returns correct counts (gudang=2, vendor=4, buyer=8, total=14)
BACKEND B: All filters work correctly (source=gudang/vendor/buyer, date_from/date_to, q search, combined filters)
BACKEND C: PDF URLs for all 3 sources return valid PDFs (HTTP 200, %PDF- magic bytes)
BACKEND D: Recap PDF generation works with Authorization header and token query param, filters apply correctly, invalid token returns 401
BACKEND E: Read-only aggregation verified - no new documents created in wh_delivery_notes, vendor_shipments, buyer_shipments, counters
BACKEND F: Regression tests passed - old endpoints still work, /sources route not caught by /{sj_id}, GET by ID works
FRONTEND 1: 'Semua Sumber' tab active by default with badge count (14), table displays all 3 source types with correct badges
FRONTEND 2: Source filter chips work (all/gudang/vendor/buyer), date filters work (future date returns 0), search filter works
FRONTEND 3: PDF download buttons work for all sources with success toast, buyer rows have cumulative PDF button (pdf_alt_url)
FRONTEND 4: 'Cetak Rekap' button works with success toast, CSV export button works
FRONTEND 5: 'Buka sumber' navigation works - vendor rows navigate to Kirim Material CMT
FRONTEND 6: Regression passed - SJ Gudang tab works (2 rows), Draft/Issued/Received tabs accessible, 'Surat Jalan Baru' button exists

FRONTEND 7: H-8 menu alias redirects work - #do-management → Kirim Material CMT, #prod-cmt-packing → Terima FG dari CMT, #maklon-packing → Terima FG dari CMT, #cmt-progress → Monitoring CMT, no redirect loops
REGRESSION H-5/H-6: wms-fabric-rolls loads with 'Penerimaan tanpa roll' tab visible, cutting-orders module loads
